meta.title: RFP's bid window may not outlast the RFQ's
gaps: The available operations cannot schedule the technical round before publishing; the plan attempts the technical extension on the draft and then publishes if the extension is refused.
The expected error message is not asserted because assertion fields for write-operation error responses are not available.

words.preconditions: A fresh draft event with a technical (RFP) round and a pricing (RFQ) round attached, not published.
steps: The buyer moves the technical round's bid end time with the increase auction time set to “{{rfpEnd+60}}”.
As the buyer, read the event and check that the event is still a draft (not published).
words.expected: The app refuses the step the case is about with “RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.”, and never with a server error. Read back afterwards: the event is still a draft (not published).

plan.title: RFP's bid window may not outlast the RFQ's

assert.say: the event is still a draft (not published)

expected.message: RFP duration exceeds RFQ end time. Please adjust.
